text:
alex: Quick sync on the module cutover playbook draft. I added a tech-debt classification column and a lightweight checklist for each slice.

lee: Nice. Can you paste the checklist example?

alex: sure 
```
- perf smoke (p95, mem)
- api contract check (backward compat)
- tenant isolation test (chaos net)
- rollback snippet (2 steps)
- cost guardrail (quota)
```

toni: Love the checklist. A couple of policy items: 1) any slice with cross-tenant shared state must be tagged BLOCKING. 2) migrations that require downtime need product signoff.

morgan: Agree on blocking definition. Also add a "data migration safe" boolean. Some caches are fine to warm; some need explicit rehydrate plan.

alex: Good call. I added fields: debt_class (blocking|tolerable), migration_safe (yes|no), preferred_infra (dedicated|shared).

lee: For the rollback snippets, keep them super minimal. Example for enrichment-worker: 1) cut new consumer flag; 2) flip traffic to previous worker; 3) rollback DB migration if flagged.

toni: We should also include who owns the rollback during cutover (not necessarily the service owner). Suggest a separate ops lead per domain.

alex: I'll add a fallback_ops field and require a pager assignment before any canary.

ci-bot: Reminder: attach a small smoke-prometheus job to each canary and tag dashboards with "module-cutover/<slice>".

morgan: On the tech-debt taxonomy: propose categories: safety (cross-tenant leaks), correctness (consistency gaps), operability (missing metrics/alerts), cost (inefficient hotspots), and testability.

lee: Annotate rows with short remediation expected time (hrs) so product can prioritize what must be fixed pre-cutover.

alex: Good idea. I'll add an "est_remed_hours" cell. Also adding a pre-cutover checklist gate: no blocking debt, SLAs agreed, fallback_ops assigned, smoke job present.

toni: For the phased traffic shift, prefer: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over configurable windows with automated rollback triggers (error_budget_burn, p95_increase > 2x, memory > threshold).

morgan: Add a manual hold step after 25% for 24h observation for any stateful slices.

lee: One friction point: consumer compatibility. We need consumers to declare migration windows and a fallback contract (graceful degrade). If not declared, block the cutover.

alex: I'll add a consumer signoff column and a product escalation flow.

ci-bot: Action created: module_cutover_matrix -> review_pending.

alex: Action items: 1) alex: publish matrix CSV + playbook PR today. 2) team leads: review & label rows within 4 business days. 3) eng-sre: prototype smoke job template + alert rules. 4) product: confirm migration windows or flag blocking integrations.

lee: I can help draft alert rules. Ping me.

toni: I'll coordinate with product for integration lists.

alex: thanks all. I'll post PR link when it's up.

morgan: :thumbsup:
